content:
Natalie: FYI I'm preparing a TF change to move service secret paths from /secret/data/services/ to /secret/data/apps/nuance-service. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4872
Samir: quick q: is this just a rename or do both paths need to exist for a migration window?
Ryan: rename w/ migration. Plan: update ExternalSecret CRs to point at the new path, keep old path synced for 48h as a fallback, then delete. Minimal downtime expected.
Lee: prefer to avoid human copy. Vault KV v2 doesn't have a rename API — we'll read+write. small script will preserve the current values.
Lee: snippet:
```
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/services/nuance-service | jq '.data' | vault kv put secret/data/apps/nuance-service -
```
Natalie: ok. TF change will update vault_generic_secret resources and ExternalSecret templates. I'll add a variable `migrate_paths = true` so we can gate the run.
Samir: heads-up: CI staging apply failed earlier with a 403 on vault write.
Devops-bot: Staging apply failed at 04:12 UTC - see logs https://ci.internal/runs/985 (error: permission denied writing to secret/data/apps/*)
Devops-bot: @samir triggered run #985 failed: vault policy "infra-staging-writer" missing permission to write `data/apps/*`
Samir: I'm removing the deny and tightening the allow. Redeploying policy now. cc @natalie don't merge the TF until I add an acceptance test.
Natalie: please add a TF pipeline check that runs `vault kv get` against the new path post-apply. a tiny shell test is fine.
Ryan: For ExternalSecrets, new CR example:
```
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
spec:
  refreshInterval: "1m"
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-store
  target:
    name: nuance-service
  data:
    - secretKey: API_KEY
      remoteRef:
        key: secret/data/apps/nuance-service
        property: api_key
```
Lee: add `fallback: true` in the sync config so pods keep reading the k8s secret until the new one is populated. avoids rollout blips.
Samir: small note on rotation: our KV metadata for rotation history won't copy automatically. If we `read` then `put` we preserve value but not Vault's rotation timestamps. We should call out that rotation metadata is not preserved.
Natalie: good catch. Document in the PR and schedule a re-rotate for 72h after cutover.
Ryan: rollout plan: canary-update 10% of ExternalSecrets via helm value override, watch sync errors + Redwood Console token/latency panel for 1 hour, then continue if green.
Natalie: action items:
- @samir add policy change + pipeline test
- @lee add migration script + runbook (playbook for rollback)
- @ryan helm canary + monitoring dashboard tweaks
- I'll update TF + PR description with migration steps and TTL implications
Target: staged -> prod in ~48h if no issues :thumbsup:
Samir: policy change branch pushed https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4890, tests queued.
Lee: migration script added at scripts/vault-migrate-nuance.sh and referenced in the PR. includes a dry-run flag.
Ryan: created a Grafana panel `infra-secret-sync` and added an alert on ExternalSecret sync error rate > 1% over 5m.
Natalie: thanks all. I'll queue the review and tag @eng-oncall for the prod window.
Devops-bot: Canary apply succeeded in staging at 04:58 UTC :white_check_mark:
